The print shows a patched coat with gear straps, trousers, with a scarf and goggles printed on the hood, boots printed on the feet, and the sleeves end in plain cuffs with no hands printed. The back of the suit shows the matching back of the outfit, printed edge to edge, from the collar or hood to the ankles or feet. No background colour or plain jersey shows around the print, on the shoulders, sleeves or legs. The outfit's cloth wraps the whole suit like a pattern, with the body, the outside and inside of each sleeve and each leg, and the sides, so there are no plain coloured side panels or background patches anywhere. There are no printed arms, hands, fingers, legs or feet and no printed skin on the suit, except a small printed neckline detail where the outfit is open. Every part of the shirt, shoulders and sleeves included, shows the outfit's own colours and cloth texture in one uniform print. The print is cut exactly to the suit, neck, shoulders, armholes, sleeves and hem are all covered in the outfit's own fabric. The silhouette is a plain one-piece suit, with every part of the outfit printed inside its shape and none beyond it. The outfit is laid out on the suit's own rectangle shape, fully covering it from side seam to side seam. Everything is flat ink on opaque stretch jersey, lace, fur, metal, leather and sequins are printed patterns, never real raised or see-through material. No standing figure, torso, arms or legs are depicted; the suit's own shape is the body, and the print is only the outfit's fabric covering it from edge to edge. It is a trompe-l'oeil onesie, a plain one-piece suit pretending to be the outfit through printing alone. It is a complete costume of fallen-world scavenger in one piece, shown full length from collar to ankles, with a patched coat with gear straps, trousers on the legs, a scarf and goggles (as the hood), boots (as the feet), a pack sewn or attached to the suit. The upper half carries the top and the leg tubes carry the lower garment, so the whole outfit reads at once. Sewn-on novelty extras, kept to the edges so the print stays unbroken, with a chunky pom-pom zipper pull, a fluffy pom-pom at the tip of the hood and a fuzzy collar edge. It is a bright, playful novelty onesie that is fun to touch.
